note: The status registry's data (4.5.0 "Wiki", docs/dev/PLAN-4.5-WIKI.md §4.4.2, phase A5; read by tools/wiki/contracts.ts): per product surface, its contract status (experimental, stable, deprecated), quoted from docs/en|fr/SUPPORT.md (tests/contracts.test.ts checks the quotes are there and say that status); the environments the support matrix says CI verifies, as of `asOf`; the automated checks that cover it (ci:plan's gates, CI and candidate jobs, test files); and the people's passes it waits for (ids of tools/field/schema.ts and docs/dev/surfaces.json). The passes' states are never written here: they are read from docs/dev/passes/<version>.md, with the issue that tracks each (`passIssues`). Known limits are the pages' own [!LIMIT] blocks. A wiki page names its surfaces in the manifest (`surfaces`); its header shows the five statuses separately.
